digest.title: University of Manchester Uses NVIDIA Earth-2 to Forecast Air Pollution Across the UK
OpenAI boss says world 'right to be afraid' but should trust AI firms
digest.tldr: Sam Altman and other tech CEOs say there are incentives to limit advancements in AI, as fears grow over the threats it poses to humanity.

digest.title: NASA Invites Media to International Observe the Moon Night
‘Now We Can Know Everything and Do Anything,’ Jensen Huang Says at Dreamforce
We don’t need AI regulation — leave safety to us, Nvidia’s Jensen Huang says
digest.tldr: AI isn't some new form of "alien mind," according to Jensen Huang.  It's just hardware and software, so safety can be engineered by each AI product maker.
